title: This Week’s Best PC Add‑Ons in MSFS: EDDC Dresden Steals the Show + Water Fixes & Road Lights!
description:
On April 17, 2026, the MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update is packed with fresh PC drops! While we aren’t seeing a new "must‑have aircraft" today, the absolute highlight of the week is Atelic’s EDDC Dresden Airport—a perfect pick for simmers who love highly detailed, polished hub-style airports to expand their European network. 😄

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:
🛫 Developer: Atelic: EDDC DRESDEN AIRPORT (Highly detailed German hub for PC and Xbox)
🛫 Developer: Burning Blue Design: EGBP Cotswold Airport (Kemble) (Iconic UK airfield for PC)
🛫 Developer: South Oak Co: WMPA Lumut Airport (New regional strip for PC and Xbox)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)

🌆 Developer: Dreamscenery: Gothenborg Region Water Fix (Water fix)
